results.title: Panasonic expands Budapest electronics manufacturing centre
results.description: Panasonic has expanded Budapest support for electronics manufacturing operations regionally. The 860m² centre adds SMT demonstrations, training, engineering, maintenance support and predictive software for Central and Eastern European manufacturers. results.title: Scientists Develop Swallowable Paper Battery To Power Medical Devices Inside The Body
results.description: MIT researchers have created a swallowable paper battery that can power medical devices inside the stomach for three days before safely breaking down.
